cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Measuring length, weight, time, temperature and amounts; rulers, scales and thermometers have no readable numbers.

words.en: The ruler is thirty centimetres long.
words.scene: a ruler next to a small caterpillar
more: My pencil is fifteen centimetres long.
我的铅笔有十五厘米长。
The baby snail is one centimetre long.

words.en: The wall is two metres high.
words.scene: Dad measuring a wall with a long tape measure
more: Max runs one hundred metres very fast.
Max 跑一百米跑得很快。
The water in the small pool is one metre deep.

words.en: The school is one kilometre away.
words.scene: a long straight road across fields to the far hills
more: We walk two kilometres in the park.
Dad drives ten kilometres to work.
爸爸开车十公里去上班。

words.en: I need one hundred grams of food.
words.scene: a few blueberries on a small kitchen scale
more: A small sweet is about one gram.

words.en: Mum buys one kilogramme of potatoes.
words.scene: a bag of potatoes on a kitchen scale
more: This bag of rice is two kilogrammes.

words.en: Please buy a litre of milk.
words.scene: a big one-litre bottle of milk
more: Tom drinks half a litre of water.
The big bottle holds two litres of juice.
Water gets very hot at one hundred degrees.
水到一百度就非常烫了。
Today is one degree warmer than yesterday.

words.sz: 妈妈检查 Tom 的体温。
words.scene: Mum sitting on the bed beside Tom, holding a small thermometer to check his temperature, Tom with a warm red face and sleepy eyes under a light blanket, a cup of water on the table.

words.en: Lily can swim under the water for ten seconds.
words.sz: Lily 能在水下游十秒钟。
words.scene: Tom holding his nose and sinking under the water of a swimming pool, his big sister Lily counting on her fingers at the side of the pool.
more: Max runs to the gate in five seconds.
Max 五秒钟就跑到了大门口。

words.scene: Tom putting on his shoes by the front door while Lily waits holding her bag, a small egg timer ticking on the hall table.
more: The bus comes in one minute.

words.en: The film is two hours long.
words.scene: Lily and Tom sitting on the sofa watching television in the evening, a big hour-glass with sand running down standing on the table beside them.
more: Dad works eight hours every day.

words.en: We go to school every day.
words.scene: A bright daytime sky with a big sun over a small school building, children with bags walking through the gate.

Lily standing in front of a kitchen wall calendar that shows one row of seven big squares, each square with a small picture: a school bag, a paintbrush, a swimming pool, a cake, a football, a bike and a sun; she points at the row.
more: Lily cleans her room once a week.
Lily 每周打扫一次房间。

words.scene: Lily standing with her back against the kitchen door frame while Mum marks her height on the frame with a pencil, a small birthday cake with one candle on the table beside them.
Mum on the phone holding up one finger to Tom, asking him to wait.
more: I will be back in a moment.

words.scene: One red apple cut into two equal halves on a plate, half of it still in Lily's hand.
more: Tom gives Sam half his cake.
Tom 给 Sam 一半蛋糕。

words.en: It is a quarter past three.
words.scene: a pizza cut into four, one quarter taken away
more: Lily eats one quarter of the pizza.
We wait for a quarter of an hour.
